# `fp` standard library

The `fp` module provides generic higher-order combinators, function composition utilities,
and functional collection helpers adapted to Dva's zero-overhead, type-erased execution model.

```dva
#use fp
// or import directly into unqualified scope:
#use(import) fp
```

## Function application & composition

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apply` | `(T => U), T => U` | Applies function `f` to argument `x` (`f $ x`) |
| `apply2` | `(T, U => V), T, U => V` | Applies binary function `f(a, b)` |
| `apply3` | `(T, U, V => W), T, U, V => W` | Applies ternary function `f(a, b, c)` |
| `twice` | `(T => T), T => T` | Applies `f` twice: `f(f(x))` |
| `thrice` | `(T => T), T => T` | Applies `f` three times: `f(f(f(x)))` |
| `flip` | `(T, U => V), U, T => V` | Swaps the arguments of a binary function: `f(b, a)` |
| `compose` | `(B => C), (A => B) => (A => C)` | Curried right-to-left composition: `f(g(x))` |
| `pipe` | `(A => B), (B => C) => (A => C)` | Curried left-to-right composition: `g(f(x))` |
| `const` | `A => (B => A)` | Constant combinator: ignores second argument |
| `on` | `(T, T => V), (T => T), T, T => V` | Applies unary transform to both arguments before binary combination |
| `ident` | `T => T` | Identity function: returns argument unchanged |
| `tap` | `T, (T => ()) => T` | Runs side-effect function on `v`, returning `v` unchanged |

```dva
inc: Int => Int
inc = x => x + 1

dbl: Int => Int
dbl = x => x * 2

pipeline = pipe(dbl, inc)
result = pipeline(10) // 21
```

## Predicate combinators

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `complement` | `(T => <>) => (T => <>)` | Logical NOT of a predicate (`!pred(x)`) |
| `both` | `(T => <>), (T => <>) => (T => <>)` | Logical AND of two predicates (`p1(x) && p2(x)`) |
| `either_pred` | `(T => <>), (T => <>) => (T => <>)` | Logical OR of two predicates (`p1(x) \|\| p2(x)`) |

```dva
is_pos: Int => <>
is_pos = n => n > 0

is_even: Int => <>
is_even = n => n % 2 == 0

pos_even = both(is_pos, is_even)
pos_even(4) // <+>
pos_even(-2) // <->
```

## Collection transformations & reductions

Collection combinators operate generically over growable arrays `(T){}`, slice views `(T[])`,
and homogeneous records. All multi-argument collection combinators place the collection in
the last parameter position, enabling functional application with `apply ($)`:

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `map` | `(A => B), Coll => (B){}` | Applies `f` to each element, returning a new array |
| `filter` | `(T => <>), Coll => Coll` | Keeps elements satisfying predicate `pred` |
| `reject` | `(T => <>), Coll => Coll` | Inverse of `filter`: removes elements satisfying `pred` |
| `reduce` | `(Acc, E => Acc), Acc, Coll => Acc` | Left fold with explicit initial value |
| `fold` | `(Acc, E => Acc), Acc, Coll => Acc` | Alias to `reduce` |
| `scan` | `(Acc, E => Acc), Acc, Coll => (Acc){}` | Running left reduction, emitting each intermediate accumulator |
| `reverse` | `Coll => Coll` | Returns container with elements in reversed order |
| `flatten` | `((E){}){} => (E){}` | Flattens a nested array of arrays into a single-level array |
| `find` | `(E => <>), Coll => < E \| >` | Finds first element satisfying `pred`, returning `RamPN` |
| `any` | `(E => <>), Coll => <>` | Checks if at least one element satisfies `pred` |

```dva
nums = Int{}
nums += 1
nums += 2
nums += 3
nums += 4

sum = reduce(add, 0, nums) // 10
odds = reject(is_even, nums) // [1, 3]
running = scan(add, 0, nums) // [0, 1, 3, 6, 10]
```

## Slicing & sequence views

Slicing operations return zero-copy slice views `(T[])` bounded by collection length `0..?xs`.
Callers make an owned copy explicitly when independent storage is needed.

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `take` | `Int, (T[]) => (T[])` | Slice view of first `n` elements (clamped to `0..?xs`) |
| `drop` | `Int, (T[]) => (T[])` | Slice view omitting first `n` elements (clamped to `0..?xs`) |
| `take_while` | `(T => <>), (T[]) => (T[])` | Slice view of leading elements where `pred` holds |
| `drop_while` | `(T => <>), (T[]) => (T[])` | Slice view starting from the first non-matching element |
| `partition` | `(T => <>), (T[]) => (passed: (T){}, rejected: (T){})` | Splits collection into passed and rejected arrays |
| `sort` | `(T[]), (T, T => <>) => ()` | In-place insertion sort of slice view with comparison predicate |

```dva
sl = nums(..)
first2 = take(2, sl)
rest = drop(2, sl)
split = partition(is_even, sl)
```

## Pairing & multi-collection combinators

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `zip` | `(A[]), (B[]) => ((A, B)){}` | Pairs elements into 2-tuples until shorter collection ends |
| `zip_with` | `(A, B => C), (A[]), (B[]) => (C){}` | Combines elements pairwise using `f` until shorter collection ends |

```dva
a = Int{}
a += 1
a += 2

b = String{}
b += "x"
b += "y"

pairs = zip(a(..), b(..)) // [(1, "x"), (2, "y")]
```
